email.automated_notice: This is an automated notification. Please do not reply to this email.

checkout_receipt.subject: Checkout Receipt: {item_title}
checkout_receipt.heading: Item Checked Out
checkout_receipt.body: You have successfully checked out the following item:
checkout_receipt.return_reminder: Please return this item by the due date so others can enjoy it too!
checkout_receipt.return_reminder_extended: Please return this item by the due date so others can enjoy it too! You can return items at any library branch or book drop.

due_date_reminder.subject: Due Date Reminder: {item_title}
due_date_reminder.heading: Due Date Reminder
due_date_reminder.body: This is a friendly reminder that the following item is due in {days_until_due} day(s):
due_date_reminder.return_or_renew: Please return or renew this item before the due date.
due_date_reminder.return_or_renew_extended: Please return or renew this item before the due date. Need more time? You can easily renew online or at the library!

overdue_notice.subject: Overdue Notice: {item_title}
overdue_notice.heading: Overdue Notice
overdue_notice.body: The following item is now {days_overdue} day(s) overdue.
overdue_notice.body_extended: The following item is now {days_overdue} day(s) overdue. Please return it as soon as possible.
overdue_notice.return_message: Please return this item when you can so others can enjoy it.
overdue_notice.return_message_extended: We know life gets busy! Please return this item when you can so others can enjoy it. You can return items at any library branch or book drop. Need help? Just ask!

hold_ready.subject: Your Hold is Ready: {item_title}
hold_ready.heading: Your Hold is Ready!
hold_ready.body: Great news! The item you placed on hold is now available for pickup.
hold_ready.pickup_reminder: Please pick up your item by the date shown above.
hold_ready.pickup_reminder_extended: Please pick up your item by the date shown above. After this date, the hold will expire and the item will be made available to the next patron in line.

hold_expiring.subject: Hold Expiring Soon: {item_title}
hold_expiring.heading: Hold Expiring Soon
hold_expiring.body: Your hold will expire in {days_until_expiry} day(s). Please pick up your item soon!
hold_expiring.expiry_warning: If you don't pick up this item before it expires, it will be made available to the next patron in line.

hold_cancelled.subject: Hold Cancelled: {item_title}
hold_cancelled.heading: Hold Cancelled
hold_cancelled.body: Your hold on the following item has been cancelled.

fine_notice.subject: Fine Notice - {amount}
fine_notice.heading: Fine Notice
fine_notice.body: A fine of {amount} has been added to your account.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {library_name}!
welcome.heading: Welcome to the Library!
welcome.body: Your library account has been created successfully. Your library card number is:
welcome.get_started: Get started by browsing our catalog, checking out events, or exploring our digital resources.

password_reset.subject: Password Reset Request
password_reset.heading: Password Reset
password_reset.body: We received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to create a new password.
password_reset.expiry_notice: This link will expire in {hours} hours.
password_reset.ignore_notice: If you didn't request this, you can safely ignore this email.

account_deletion.subject: Account Deletion Scheduled
account_deletion.heading: Account Deletion Scheduled
account_deletion.body: Your account has been scheduled for deletion on {date}.
account_deletion.cancel_notice: If you change your mind, you can cancel this request before that date by logging into your account.

due_group.subject_predue: Friendly reminder: items due in 3 days
due_group.intro_predue: Just a heads-up: these items are due in 3 days.
due_group.subject_due_today: Reminder: your library items are due today
due_group.intro_due_today: These items are due today. Return or renew now to avoid overdue notices.
due_group.subject_overdue: Overdue notice (Day {day}) - please return your library items
due_group.intro_overdue: This is your day {day} overdue notice. Please return these items as soon as possible.

notifications.hold_ready: Item {item_title} is ready for pickup until {expires_at}
notifications.hold_cancelled: Your hold on {item_title} has been cancelled
notifications.fine_added: A fine of {amount} was added to your account

sms.panic_alert: URGENT: Panic alert at {location}. Staff: {staff_name}. Check app NOW. Alert #{alert_number}
